# AIRForge

AIRForge is a JEE Main and JEE Advanced preparation workspace for Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.

Purpose:
- Daily study planning and focus sessions
- Chapter-level mastery evidence
- PYQ workflows
- Test and revision planning
- Error analysis and spaced revision
- Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics practice engines

Primary page:
https://airforgehub.pages.dev/

Core pages:
https://airforgehub.pages.dev/physics.html
https://airforgehub.pages.dev/chemistry.html
https://airforgehub.pages.dev/maths.html
